nodes.label: MRP CLI (scripts/mrp)
nodes.rationale: Everything the admin UI does is also scriptable; --json output and reports/ enable automation by agents.

nodes.label: enrich-links (Odesli enrichment)
nodes.rationale: Additive only — never overwrite a set value; ODESLI_API_KEY raises rate limit from 10 to 60 req/min.

nodes.label: Frozen WordPress Migration Policy
nodes.rationale: The WP migration is complete and closed; its tools and content/clone/ + content/import-review/ trees are frozen read-only so new work targets only the structured YAML catalog.

nodes.label: No Credentials in Git Policy
nodes.rationale: API keys and SSH deploy settings load from the environment or an untracked .env at the repo root, never committed.

nodes.label: Generated Output Outside Repo Policy
nodes.rationale: builds/, site/dist/, site/.astro/, graphify-out/ and $MRP_SITE_OUT_ROOT/* are disposable; site output must live outside the repo (default ~/astro-sites/maricoparecords) to keep the repo canonical-source-only.

nodes.label: Canto Agent Governance
nodes.rationale: Governed work follows .canto/agents/ manuals; assignment, Guardrail, review, Result, Approval, and Apply rules must not be bypassed.

nodes.label: Admin Web UI (FastAPI + Jinja2 + HTMX)
nodes.rationale: Primary way releases are worked from draft to live; local app with no build step, Python changes need restart, templates live-reload.

nodes.label: Slice-Save YAML IO
nodes.rationale: All YAML IO goes through load_structured_record/serialize_structured_record; each stage patches only the keys it owns so concurrent edits to other sections survive.

nodes.label: Artist Change Migration Workflow
nodes.rationale: Because artifacts are keyed by artist_id, changing a release's artist_id on the Details stage triggers a confirmation workflow that renames/re-keys everything via artist_artifact_moves/migrate_artist_artifacts in mrp/admin/workspace.py.

nodes.label: Sampler Stage
nodes.rationale: Plays the master in-browser, marks start/end, cuts a -14 LUFS preview snippet via ffmpeg into site/public/samples/.

nodes.label: Promoter Stage
nodes.rationale: Regenerates the artist's promo blurb and bios from recent releases + reviews; human review marks bio_auto_generated false.

nodes.label: Publish Pipeline (build > stage > verify > approve > publish)
nodes.norm_label: publish pipeline (build > stage > verify > approve > publish)

nodes.label: MRP Admin v0.2 (Complete)
nodes.rationale: Proven live: two releases (A Distant Memory, On To Potter's Field) published to production end-to-end through the UI.

nodes.label: Near-term Cleanup Items
nodes.rationale: Split blurb vs liner in critic records; decide monitoring stage scope; re-run enrich-links across catalog after per-track + pandora support landed.

nodes.label: Artist YAML Record
nodes.rationale: content/artists/{id}.yaml; artist IDs are lowercase URL slugs and the key prefix for all downstream release artifacts; carries the promoter-managed profile (promo_blurb, bio_short, bio_long, bio_auto_generated).

nodes.label: Release YAML Record
nodes.rationale: content/releases/{slug}.yaml; includes links, seo, automation (allow_auto_publish, links_na), and track fields (preview_audio, master_path, lyrics, style, hints, critic settings).

nodes.label: Song vs Album Release Models
nodes.rationale: song model: one single with fields under song:; album model: ep/album with tracks under tracks:.

nodes.label: JSON Schema Validation (mrp/schemas)
nodes.rationale: The schemas are the authority; docs are orientation only. Content is validated before build/deploy.

nodes.label: Track Hints (human ground truth)
nodes.rationale: Human-entered cues (e.g. Vocals: Male) trusted by the critic pipeline over unreliable audio-tagging output; Suno-style tags in lyrics_raw are production directions, not lyrics.
